subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 1: In the classroom – What's this? + Sound f
outcomes: I can say teacher, whiteboard, door and window.
I can ask and answer: What's this? It's a …
I can hear the f sound in fish, five and fan.

tf.s: Fish starts with the f sound.
Rabbit starts with the f sound.
tf.why: Rabbit starts with r. Five starts with f.

tf.s: We ask Who's this? about a person.
tf.why: Great! Who's this? is for people.

tf.s: We ask Who's this? about a door.
tf.why: For a thing, we ask What's this?
Yes! Sami says: It's my teacher, Miss Zahra.

tf.s: There is a dog at the window.
tf.why: Look again! It's a cat at the window.

tf.s: f – i – t makes the word fit.
A friend gives you a pen. You say Goodbye!
tf.why: We say Thank you when a friend gives us something.

tf.s: In the morning we say Good morning.
tf.why: Yes! Good morning is a nice hello.

tf.s: Four and five start with the letter f.
tf.why: Right! Four and five both start with f.

boxes.q: What's this? We go in and out of the room with it.
boxes.why: We open the door to go in and out.

boxes.q: Who's this? She teaches the class.
What is the first letter of fish?
Your friend helps you. What do you say?
boxes.why: Thank you is a kind thing to say.

boxes.q: You don't understand. What do you say?
boxes.why: It's OK to say I don't understand.

boxes.q: f – i – n. What's the word?
Which word does NOT start with f?
boxes.why: Door starts with d, not f.

boxes.q: What's this? You can see outside through it.
boxes.why: We look outside through the window.

boxes.q: It's your turn in a game. What do you say?
boxes.why: We say It's my turn when we play.

hunt.q: A number that starts with f
At the window there is a …

mcq.why: A teacher is a person. The others are things.

mcq.q: What sound does the fish card show?
What do we say to the teacher in the morning?
mcq.why: Good morning is how we say hello in the morning.

mcq.q: The teacher points to the door. What's this?
mcq.why: We answer What's this? with It's a …

mcq.q: You need help with your work. What do you say?
mcq.why: Can you help me? asks for help.

mcq.q: Listen: f – i – g. What's the word?
Your friend points to Miss Zahra. What does your friend ask?
mcq.why: Miss Zahra is a person, so we ask Who's this?

mcq.q: Which group of words all start with f?
mcq.why: Four, five and fish all start with f.

mcq.q: You bump into a friend by mistake. What do you say?
mcq.why: We say I'm sorry when we make a mistake.
